description: Permanently delete an attachment in your organization, including its stored file. No LLM call. Existing records remain, but future calls or schema regeneration cannot reuse the deleted source. Delete only when that source is no longer needed; this is not a required post-enrichment step. Returns the deleted ID and filename.

attachment_id.description: UUID of the attachment to delete.
attachment_id.title: Attachment Id
